simorgh.name: Simorgh News
simorgh.summary: An AI newsroom that turns world news into ready-to-publish Telegram posts.
simorgh.problem: Running a news channel alone means hours of reading sources and rewriting posts every day.
simorgh.solution: A pipeline collects articles every 30 minutes, an LLM drafts posts in Russian, and the editor approves them in a web panel or right in Telegram.
simorgh.result: Running 24/7 on a cloud server since September 2026. {count} articles processed; publishing a post takes one click.

process.title: How I work
process.lead: Four steps, the same on every project. You always know what is happening and what comes next.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: You describe the idea. I reply with a short plan: features, conversation flow and timeline. Work starts after you confirm.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: I develop the bot, connect the AI model and the database, and share progress along the way.

steps.title: Test
steps.text: You try the bot in Telegram. I fix issues and apply your revisions.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: You get the source code and setup instructions. On the Full AI System plan, the bot is deployed and running.

about.title: Hi, I'm Mahmud
paragraphs: I study Computer Science at MISIS in Dushanbe and build automation systems for people who would rather not do the same task twice. My first production system, Simorgh, has been running on a cloud server since September 2026.
I keep things simple on purpose: fewer moving parts, clear code, and documentation good enough that another developer can take over tomorrow.

contact.title: Tell me what you want to automate
contact.lead: I reply within 24 hours. A good first message answers three questions:
questions: What do you or your team do by hand today?
Where does the information live: Telegram, a website, a spreadsheet?
What should happen when the bot is done?
